summary: Iteration 60: tested the virtual stamp duty feature (bollo virtuale: auto/forced, charging it to the client with an N1 line, rate, no duplicate line, XML DatiBollo, courtesy PDF, print page, storno totale), the /api/bolli report plus the /bolli-virtuali page, and the clickable Bilancio with the SchedaConto sheet and editing a registration. Backend: 17/17 pytest tests pass. Frontend: all requested flows work at desktop and 390px mobile. One frontend bug: the UI credit-note-from-invoice flow (/fatture/nuova?da=) copies the bollo line as a normal editable line.

minor.issue: Lines are filtered with descrizione.startswith('Imposta di bollo assolta in modo virtuale') even when bollo=false, so a user line with that wording is silently dropped. Filtering only on ln.bollo plus the exact BOLLO line text would be safer.

The 2 EUR N1 bollo charged to the client is booked as revenue (20.01.001 Ricavi vendite merci, 102 EUR on the sale entry). The amount charged back is usually booked as a recovered expense on the bollo cost account, not as sales revenue. This is a business decision: confirm with the user.

ui_bugs.issue: When a credit note is started from an invoice that has the client-charged bollo line (/fatture/nuova?da=<id>, also with righe/perc), the lines are mapped without the `bollo` flag. The bollo line then shows as a normal editable 2 EUR N1 line and BOLLO_LINE is added again. Preview shows Imponibile N1 4,00 and Totale 104,00 EUR (server saves 102,00), plus a false 'Residuo stornabile ... riduci gli importi' warning. With perc the line becomes e.g. 1 EUR. The server normalises on save, so the saved NC is correct (102 EUR, 1 line). Fix: skip l.bollo lines in creditFrom/partialLines (keep the righe indices aligned) or carry the bollo flag.

issues: Date fields use the browser's native input type=date instead of the shadcn calendar (this was already the case before this change)
The statement table scrolls horizontally inside the sheet. It works, but the Data/N. column is hidden until the user scrolls.

action_items: InvoiceEditor creditFrom: exclude lines with bollo:true (or keep the flag) so the NC preview total matches the server and the bollo line is not editable or duplicated
Optional: in _apply_bollo, filter only on ln.bollo plus the exact bollo line text
Optional: decide which account the client-charged bollo (N1) should be posted to in registra_vendita
critical_code_review_comments: server.py _apply_bollo: `[...] or body.lines` keeps the bollo lines if they are the only lines. This is acceptable because min_length=1, but such an invoice would contain only a bollo line.

Bolli report counts storno credit notes (NC) as stamp duty owed, as the user chose. When the client has bollo_addebito, the storno NC also gets the 2 EUR N1 line again, so the NC total equals the invoice total. This is consistent.
fatturapa.py: DatiBollo order is correct (after DatiRitenuta, before DatiCassaPrevidenziale/ImportoTotaleDocumento)
GET /api/contabilita/registrazioni/{rid}: company isolation and 404 are fine, there is no _id leak, and operatore can read it (rows are read-only in the UI, PUT returns 403)

success_rate.frontend: 95% (all flows OK; 1 preview bug in the credit-note-from-invoice flow)

test_credentials: Used test sessions created via mongosh (admin + operatore TEST users); admin from /app/memory/test_credentials.md not modified
seed_data_creation: TEST_T60 companies, parties, invoices, coa records and users were created per run and deleted by company id afterwards (verified 0 leftovers)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: cd /app/backend && pytest tests/test_iteration60_bollo_bilancio.py -v -n 0. UI fixtures: T60_RUN=<6 digits> python tests/ui_setup_t60.py setup (prints cid, tokens, inv_add = sent+consegnata invoice with client-charged bollo, inv_b, rid = manual registrazione 06.02.001/06.01.001), then clean with the same T60_RUN. Use the session_token cookie and localStorage fe_company_id. To check the fix, open /fatture/nuova?da=<inv_add>: summary-totale should be 102,00 with only 1 line-row.
rca of the issue: InvoiceEditor.creditFrom maps original lines to plain objects (descrizione, quantita, ...) and drops `bollo: true`. So baseLines (form.lines.filter(!l.bollo)) includes the original bollo line, and bolloState().add appends BOLLO_LINE again in the computeTotals preview. Reproduce: send an invoice for a client with bollo_addebito and 100 EUR N2.2, then click Crea nota di credito (or open /fatture/nuova?da=<id>): the preview total is 104 EUR. Fix: filter `!l.bollo` in creditFrom/partialLines.
